package.name: panda_mujoco_bridge
package.description: MuJoCo-based simulated hardware bridge for the Franka Panda, standing in for a real robot on the panda_opensot_node/pose_commander pipeline - single-arm counterpart of tiago_pro_mujoco_bridge for the WBC ablation (see project memory panda_wbc_ablation_goal). Reuses tiago_pro_mujoco_bridge's EpisodeRecorder and episode_orchestrator_node directly (both already robot-agnostic).
